messages:
Maria: quick favor — can eng-runtime run a lightweight onboarding bench for atlas-11b-v3? smoke + 1k-token sweep, target ~8x V100 equiv, seq=1024 batch=4. please do one warm-cache pass and one cold. include tail latency (p95/p99) and tokens/sec. @Ken @Zoe

Ken: on it. scheduling smoke now. do you want fp16 profile-default or try q4 as well?

Maria: start with fp16 profile-default (no q4). uniform token lengths 1-1024. include small profiler trace and raw logs.

perf-bot: job queued: job-id=atlas-v3-2141594321, runner=perf-run-07

Ken: smoke finished. quick summary:

```
warm:   p50=22ms p95=86ms p99=122ms tps=440
cold:   p50=31ms p95=165ms p99=240ms tps=320
config: seq=1024 batch=4 fp16-profile-default
```

Zoe: uploading profiler: gs://redwood-perf/atlas-v3/2141594321/profiler/trace.html
Found KV cache miss bursts at layers 6-7 during cold first tokens. Also saw a kernel fallback warning around step 1.

Julian: thanks — looks like kernel selection fell back on matmul-optimized path. I'll force kernel set C and re-run; expect p99 improvement ~10-20% if that's the main issue.

Ken: noted. throughput variance increases a lot for seq>900, I'll run stratified bins to isolate. also capturing GPU utilization samples.

Julian: kernel-C run done: p99 warm=109ms (was 122), p99 cold=205ms (was 240). tps warm=475. attaching diff.

Maria: nice improvement. next steps: 1) reproduce on a different runner, 2) run full 1k-token sweep overnight with kernel-C, 3) document recommended kernel map + open onboarding PR. I'll file the card and link artifacts.

perf-bot: artifacts archived: gs://redwood-perf/atlas-v3/2141594321/artifacts.tar.gz

Ken: second runner reproduces kernel-C gains. overnight sweep queued.

Zoe: tagging this in model-onboarding card #4621. will follow up with a short writeup for ops and a canary plan for dedicated next week. :rocket:
